title: FizzBuzz
description:
# FizzBuzz

Given an integer $n$, print the numbers from 1 to $n$ each on a new line.
- For multiples of 3, print `Fizz` instead of the number.
- For multiples of 5, print `Buzz` instead of the number.
- For numbers which are multiples of both 3 and 5, print `FizzBuzz`.

### Input Format
- An integer $n$.

### Output Format
- $n$ lines representing the FizzBuzz sequence.

test_cases.expected_output:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz
